formal: I began searching for new employment because of the manner in which my manager treats the team, and I subsequently received an offer from another company. When I informed my current employer, they offered me a 15% raise to remain; the manager will stay the same. My plan is to accept the counteroffer and decline the other position. I have weighed the raise against the outside offer on the points that matter to me, and I have decided accordingly. I present career decisions of this kind to you every time, and I have done so for years. What is your view?
